readme:
# Niplex Obsidian skills

This repository is **public for preview** so users can inspect the exact catalogue and skill files before launch. It publishes instruction-only research skills for the Niplex Obsidian helper plugin. Each skill uses a unique five-character uppercase alphanumeric code, such as `RSH01`, and contains only `skill.json` and `SKILL.md`.

The current installable research collection includes bounded research framing (`RSH01`), academic paper triage (`RSH02`), evidence synthesis (`RSH03`), source comparison (`RSH04`), open-source investigation (`RSH05`), web research planning (`RSH06`), literature review mapping (`RSH07`), claims and citations (`RSH08`), and research report drafting (`RSH09`). The complete upstream research directory is also vendored locally under `vendor/hermes-research/optional-skills/research/` for inspection, but it is not live-connected to the helper and its scripts are not executed by Niplex.

The installable packages follow the progressive-disclosure approach described in the [Hermes Agent skills documentation](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/skills). The vendored source and MIT terms are documented in [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and preserved from the [Hermes optional research skills](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/tree/main/optional-skills/research). Niplex does not make a runtime connection to that upstream tree; the helper fetches only this repository’s reviewed packages.

The helper fetches `catalogue.json`, validates the five-character code, verifies the package digest, previews the manifest, and asks the user before writing a package into `NIPLEX-OBSIDIAN/Skills/`. Skills cannot run scripts, execute JavaScript, call remote tools, access provider keys, bypass write approvals, or replace the protected built-in prompt.

## PAT and public access

Because this repository is public, the catalogue and package files are readable without a PAT. A PAT is only needed for testing or deployment scenarios that deliberately point the helper at a private fork or private endpoint. The helper never reuses Gemini or Agnes keys; any optional marketplace token is stored in Obsidian SecretStorage.

## Preview and validation

Open `catalogue.json` and any `skills/<code>/SKILL.md` directly on GitHub to see what users will receive. The package schema is in `skill-schema.json`. The repository intentionally has no GitHub Actions workflow. The main plugin and helper use local validation and packaging only.
